body.title: Fix commit status reporting for scheduled workflows
body.body:
While going through the logs of my self-hosted Forgejo instance, I found over 100K `head commit is missing in event payload` errors in 30 days. This was a result of scheduled Actions jobs whose stored event was push but the payload only had the schedule action.

So when creating schedules and runs we should record the event explicitly and also for existing runs, use the stored commit SHA for the status.

I'm not very familiar with how to add the appropriate unit tests.

body.title: refactor: migrate DOM utils to Typescript
body.body:
This PR converts our `dom.js` utils to Typescript, adding appropriate types along the way. This continues !14508's scoped approach to tightening our frontend type-checks, in line with the feedback in https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/5859#issuecomment-2560264.

This one was a doozy to get right, but I checked through all the call sites for these that I could grep for, and I think I managed to write type annotations that accurately describe these functions' invariants and their current usage throughout the codebase. I also fixed some incorrect documentation about certain parameters. As a result, our tooling can enforce those invariants more soundly, making it easier to audit around new uses of these functions and to trim down existing uses later on (e.g. jQuery removal over time).

As a bonus, jQuery has type declarations now (via `@types/jquery`), which will make further TS ports and refactors easier to reason about in the meantime.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> We must not update `@types/jquery` past the semver-major version of `jquery` we have installed. I'm not sure how best to represent that to Renovate when the package versions don't match, but I can look into that if someone else doesn't get to it first, lol.
